hints: The array starts with one value at each position; each query either changes a point or asks for a range minimum.
Store minima in a segment tree, as in a static minimum query structure.
Only update the path from the changed leaf to the root.
analogy: The range minimum tree can be repaired by recomputing only the changed value's ancestors.
example: If values are 8,3,6 and position 2 changes to 9, the minimum on 1..3 becomes 6.
algorithm: Build a min segment tree. Type 1 sets position k to u; type 2 queries the minimum over [a,b].
correctness: Every query decomposes into fully covered tree intervals whose stored minima together give the requested minimum; each point change updates all and only affected ancestors.
complexity: O(n) build, O(log n) per operation and O(n) space.
